articles.title: Record-Breaking X-Ray Flash Could Be the Birth Cry of a Magnetar
articles.summary: A 10-minute X-ray flash from a neutron star merger may be the first clear sign of a magnetar forming. The event happened over 6 billion light-years away and was caught by the Einstein Probe satellite.

articles.title: Watch: Dwarf Crocodiles Ambush Bats in a Pitch-Black Cave
articles.summary: Scientists have filmed dwarf crocodiles hunting bats in Gabon's Abanda Caves — a behavior never seen before. The crocs live in bat guano, have orange skin, and may be evolving into a new species.

articles.title: Switzerland's Glaciers Lost 5.5% of Their Ice This Year — and They May Not Survive
articles.summary: Swiss glaciers shrank by 5.5% this year, the second-worst drop on record. In five years, they've lost nearly a fifth of their volume. Scientists say human-caused warming is entirely to blame.
